title: Lordship of God
definition: The lordship of God means that He possesses supreme authority, ownership, and rule over all creation and every life.
summary: God is Lord over all and rightly commands worship, obedience, and trust.
christFocus: Jesus is Lord, sharing divine authority and calling all people to submit to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is Lord because He is Creator, Sustainer, King, and Judge. All things belong to Him, and every person is accountable to Him.

The lordship of God means that human life is not self-owned. Worship, obedience, work, relationships, resources, and mission all come under His authority.

The confession that Jesus is Lord is central to Christian faith. He reigns with divine authority and calls His people to joyful submission.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People naturally want autonomy and control. The lordship of God matters because it confronts self-rule and calls every life under God's rightful authority.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask where you are resisting God's authority. Confess Jesus as Lord not only with words but through obedience, stewardship, worship, and trust.
